iti68:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti68:2.1: “Monks, anyone whose passion is unabandoned, whose aversion is unabandoned, whose delusion is unabandoned
iti68:2.2: is said to have gone over to Māra’s camp, has come under Māra’s power. The Evil One can do with that person as he likes.
iti68:2.3: But anyone whose passion is abandoned, whose aversion is abandoned, whose delusion is abandoned
iti68:2.4: is said not to have gone over to Māra’s camp, has thrown off Māra’s power. With that person, the Evil One cannot do as he likes.”
iti68:3.3:
is said to be
composed in mind,
iti68:3.5:
one for whom fear & hostility
are past,
